declare
 dtLocalDate DATE := get_local_date;
begin
 select TO_DATE
 (
 TO_CHAR
 (
 decode(TO_CHAR(lDate, 'AM'),'AM',ROUND(lDate),TRUNC(lDate)
 )
 ,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' 23:59','MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI'
 ) td
 INTO dtLocalDate
 FROM(
 SELECT dtLocalDate lDate--get_local_date lDate
 FROM dual
 );

 then
 show_error_dist('0503');
 end if;
end;

Block.Name: SHIPMENTS
Block.WhereClause:
WHERE chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND
Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset,shipment_date) 
 BETWEEN TRUNC(to_date(:start_date)) AND NVL(TRUNC(to_date(:end_date))+.99999,sysdate)

procedure clear_shipments_details ( checkmaster boolean, opt number ) is

procedure query_shipments_details is
begin

 not null) and :system.record_status != 'NEW' ) then
 query_details('boxes');
 end if;
 if ( (:shipments.shipment_no is not null) or (:shipments.chapter_id is
 not null) ) then

 end if;

 not null) ) then

 go_block('shipments');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_DOC_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE query_doc_details IS
 nCnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_ship_docs',enabled,property_false);
 IF :shipments.shipment_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT count(1) INTO nCnt
 FROM lt_doc_library_values
 WHERE doc_linked_value = :shipments.shipment_no;
 
 IF nCnt > 0 THEN
 set_item_property('control_block.pb_ship_docs',enabled,property_true);
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_SHIPMENT_NO_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT shipment_no,
 TO_CHAR(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, shipment_date),'mm-dd-yy'),
 co.consignee_id, short_name
FROM consignee co, shipments sh
WHERE co.consignee_id = sh.consignee_id
AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, shipment_date)
 BETWEEN TRUNC(to_date(:start_date)) AND NVL(TRUNC(to_date(:end_date))+.99999,sysdate)
 /*modified by hcl consulting*/
AND co.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
AND sh.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 /*modified by hcl consulting*/
ORDER BY shipment_date DESC
